name: agent-workflow
description: Run agent-workflow multi-agent workflows (deep-review, deep-research, spec-review, impact-review, dynamic) from the conversation: launch, wait, inspect and stop runs through the agent-workflow MCP server.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eq '"prompt"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([[:space:]]|\\[nrt])*(\$aw(([[:space:]]|\\[nrt])|")|aw("|([[:space:]]|\\[nrt])+("|(dashboard|run|dynamic|auto|stop)(([[:space:]]|\\[nrt])|"))))' || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | npx -y --package=@agwab/agent-workflow@0.1.0 agent-workflow host-command --host codex 2>/dev/null; exit 0

interface.shortDescription: Run multi-agent workflows (review, research) and report their results
